description: Twenty source-verified cases derived from three locally indexed NASA Mars documents. Expected concepts were checked against the cited PDF pages; the PDFs themselves remain excluded from Git.

cases.question: Which minerals formed through aqueous alteration in the Jezero crater-floor rocks?

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 1 lists carbonate, iron oxides, amorphous silicates, sulfates, halite, perchlorates, phosphates, and potential phyllosilicates.

cases.question: What were the first two rock cores acquired in the Rochette caprock member?

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 1 names Montdenier and Montagnac as the first two rock cores.

cases.question: How did the crater-floor overview interpret the igneous origin of the Seitah rocks?

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 1 describes Seitah as an olivine-rich cumulate.

cases.question: Which primary minerals characterize the Maaz formation rocks in the crater-floor overview?

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 1 says Maaz rocks are rich in pyroxene and plagioclase.

cases.question: As of January 1, 2022, how far had Perseverance traversed and how many sample tubes had it filled?

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 1 reports 2.886 km and six filled sample tubes.

cases.question: What depositional processes did the delta-front overview infer for most lithofacies?

source_references.filename: Williams et al_LPSC 2023 Delta Front Overview abstract_v5.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 2 attributes deposition to broadly unconfined density currents and turbidite-related processes.

cases.question: What rock types occur in the lowest members of Devils Tanyard and Hughes River Gap?

source_references.filename: Williams et al_LPSC 2023 Delta Front Overview abstract_v5.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 2 describes interbedded very fine-to-medium sandstones and inferred siltstone.

cases.question: What is unique about the Hogwallow Flats unit in the reported stratigraphy?

source_references.filename: Williams et al_LPSC 2023 Delta Front Overview abstract_v5.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 2 calls Hogwallow Flats a hydrated sulfate-cemented siltstone.

cases.question: What corridor width did the geologic context mapping document along Perseverance's traverse?

source_references.filename: Crumpler et al 2023 JGR Planets Mapping of Jezero.pdf

cases.verification_note: The page 1 abstract specifies a 120 m-wide corridor.

cases.question: What alteration products and environmental significance were reported for the crater-floor rocks?

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf

cases.verification_note: The alteration list begins on page 1 and its environmental interpretation continues on page 2.

cases.question: Which different features support aqueous alteration and diagenesis in the delta-front sections?

source_references.filename: Williams et al_LPSC 2023 Delta Front Overview abstract_v5.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 2 lists anhydrite veins, Mn-rich coatings, and spherical or irregular concretions among several indicators.

cases.question: Which imaging, contact-science, and remote-sensing instruments supported rover-based geologic mapping?

source_references.filename: Crumpler et al 2023 JGR Planets Mapping of Jezero.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 3 names Mastcam-Z and Navcams for map bases and SHERLOC, PIXL, and SuperCam for lithologic confirmation.

cases.question: How do mapping confidence Levels 5 and 1 differ in range, detail, and reliability?

source_references.filename: Crumpler et al 2023 JGR Planets Mapping of Jezero.pdf

cases.verification_note: Pages 4-5 define Level 5 and its under-7.5 m range; pages 5-6 describe Level 1 as low-fidelity dashed-line inference.

cases.question: Compare the interpreted origins of the crater-floor formations with the delta-front rocks.

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf
Williams et al_LPSC 2023 Delta Front Overview abstract_v5.pdf

cases.verification_note: Crater page 1 reports igneous origins; delta page 2 reports sedimentary deposition by density-current/turbidite processes.

cases.question: Compare the aqueous alteration evidence reported for the crater floor and delta front.

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf
Williams et al_LPSC 2023 Delta Front Overview abstract_v5.pdf

cases.verification_note: Crater page 1 lists carbonate and iron oxides; delta page 2 lists anhydrite veins, concretions, and other alteration features.

cases.question: Compare unsuccessful or compromised sampling attempts described in the crater-floor and delta-front campaigns.

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf
Williams et al_LPSC 2023 Delta Front Overview abstract_v5.pdf

cases.verification_note: Crater page 1 describes the failed Roubion acquisition; delta page 2 describes fractured or tilted abrasion targets unsuitable for coring.

cases.question: What exact air temperature did Perseverance measure at the instant it landed in Jezero crater?
cases.verification_note: The three benchmark documents do not state an exact landing-time air temperature.

cases.question: What was the rover's battery voltage during the first crater-floor drilling attempt?
cases.verification_note: The three benchmark documents do not report battery voltage for that activity.

cases.question: Which living microbes did Perseverance discover in the Jezero samples?
cases.verification_note: The question contains a false premise; none of the documents reports discovery of living microbes.

cases.question: What single confirmed mechanism tilted the Artuby ridge layers to their current orientation?

source_references.filename: mars_report.pdf

cases.verification_note: Page 2 explicitly says the post-emplacement processes are yet undetermined and the relationship is an ongoing study.
